prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 80.3%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.6%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Late Sign-In Move Before Pet Generation: Moves the sign-in step after pet adoption certificate creation so users bond with their pet before committing an account. (why: Adoption step drops to 60.9% and has a 89s median time; asking for sign-in upfront causes early friction before value is demonstrated.)
1: [finish, redesign] Desktop Controls Interactive Tutorial Walkthrough: Redesigns the home intro completion screen with an interactive checklist teaching users how to summon, hide, and talk to their desktop pet. (why: Support receives multiple inquiries regarding how to control or hide pets post-onboarding, and finish step conversion is only 64.8%.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Photo Quality Verification Sub-Flow: Introduces an automatic validation step during photo upload that checks image clarity and gives instant visual pet previews before generation. (why: Support theme indicates custom pet generation fails or looks incorrect for users (3 tickets) and adoption completion is only 60.9%.)
3: [home, notification] Desktop Display Health & Audio Completion Alert: Plays a playful desktop sound effect and sends a system tray notification when pet generation completes. (why: The mean time spent on waiting is 2336s because users tab away and miss when their pet is ready to appear.)
4: [sign_in, copy] Existing Pet Account Recovery Sign-In Banner: Revises headline and copy on the sign-in screen to explicitly assure returning users their existing pets will be instantly restored. (why: Top support theme (8 emails) is pets missing or reset after signing back into an existing account.)
5: [adoption, hint] Adoption Certificate Cloud Sync Guarantee: Adds an explicit account preservation hint and cloud badge to the adoption certificate completion screen. (why: Prevents user anxiety about losing pets upon re-login, directly targeting the primary support complaint (8 emails).)
6: [choose_path, layout] Path Selection Visual Choice Cards Stage: Replaces path selection with a full stage layout featuring vivid visual preview cards for companion archetypes. (why: The choose_path step takes a mean of 514s with 76.2% conversion; clearer visual choices speed up decision-making.)
7: [home, wait_info] Background Pet Generation Status Breakdown: Displays live step-by-step progress stages (Asset Rendering, Behavior Calibration, Desktop Hooking) on the waiting screen. (why: Users spend a median of 201s waiting without clear visibility into generation status, leading to support complaints about app stalling.)

scores.note: Reordering sign-in after value demonstration significantly reduces early drop-off at adoption (60.9%).
Interactive tutorial targets the 35.2% drop at finish and directly addresses support inquiries.
Photo quality checks address custom pet failures and low conversion (60.9%) at adoption.
Audio and tray notifications recover users who tab away during long wait times (mean 2336s).
Copy change directly targets the top support theme (8 emails) with minimal effort.
Low-cost hint addressing major account anxiety on a high drop-off step ( adoption 60.9%).
Visual cards help streamline choice latency (mean 514s) but require a full layout redesign.
Detailed progress breakdown reduces perceived stalling during the 201s median wait time.
